description: Search FCC ULS licenses and spectrum leases by callsign, licensee name, FCC Registration Number (FRN), market code, radio service, status, and licensee state, returning one row per record with its unique system identifier (USI) for fcc_spectrum_get_license. At least one of callsign, licensee, frn, market_code, radio_service, or state is required; status only narrows. Defaults to active records; pass status "any" to include expired, cancelled, and terminated ones. Licensee name matching is word-based (every word must appear as a word prefix), not fuzzy.

callsign.description: Exact callsign or lease ID, e.g. "KNKA123" or "L000012345". Case, spaces, and one trailing portable suffix ("/4") are normalized. ULS reuses callsigns, so several records can match.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search; omit for the first page.

frn.description: FCC Registration Number, up to 10 digits; spaces and hyphens are removed and it is left-padded with zeros.

licensee.description: Licensee name words, with at least one letter or digit; every word must match the start of a word in the name, in any order (e.g. "verizon wireless"). A word joined by - or & ("T-Mobile", "AT&T") matches its pieces side by side.

market_code.description: Market code of a geographic-area license, matched exactly, e.g. "PEA016", "CMA020", "D06037", or "NW" (nationwide); results carry it as marketCode. Case, spaces, and hyphens are ignored, and the digits are left-padded with zeros ("pea16" reads as PEA016).

radio_service.description: Two-character radio service code, e.g. "CD" (paging) or "BR" (BRS); see fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "radio_services".

state.description: Licensee mailing state: a two-letter USPS code (incl. DC, PR, VI, GU, AS, MP) or a full state name. This is the licensee's address, not the site location.

status.description: License status: A active, L pending legal, X term pending, E expired, C canceled, T terminated, P parent station canceled, or "any" for every status. Defaults to A.

name: fcc_spectrum_search_licenses

appliedFilters.description: Filters as the server applied them, normalized values and defaults included.

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `index_not_ready`: No completed index generation is published yet. `no_criteria`: No search field was supplied. `unknown_radio_service`: The radio service code is neither in the FCC code table nor held by the index. `service_not_indexed`: The radio service code is valid but no indexed service group carries it. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor does not decode, belongs to an earlier index generation, or is from a licensee search the daily refresh has since changed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

licenses.description: Matching records, ranked by name-match relevance when licensee is given and in callsign order otherwise.

applicantType.description: ULS applicant type code (I individual, C corporation, …), when filed.

callsign.description: Callsign, or lease ID (L + 9 digits) on a lease; absent on the few records filed without one.

frequencyCount.description: Frequency rows indexed for the record; 0 when its status is not A, L, or X.

frn.description: FCC Registration Number of the licensee, when filed.

isLease.description: True for a spectrum leasing arrangement, whose licensee is the lessee.

lastActionDate.description: Date of the last ULS action on the record (YYYY-MM-DD).

licenseStatus.description: ULS license status code (A active, E expired, C canceled, T terminated, …).

licenseeCity.description: Licensee mailing city, when filed and not redacted.

licenseeName.description: Licensee (lessee on a lease) as filed; null when redacted or not on file.

licenseeRedacted.description: True when the licensee is an individual whose name and city are withheld.

locationCount.description: Locations indexed for the record; 0 when its status is not A, L, or X, since sites are kept only for active, pending-legal, and term-pending records.

marketCode.description: Market code of a geographic-area license; pass it as market_code to list the market's licenses.

marketName.description: Market name of a geographic-area license.

radioServiceLabel.description: Label of the radio service code.

serviceGroup.description: FCC bulk-data service group the record was indexed from (e.g. "paging"); fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "coverage" lists the groups.

statusLabel.description: Label of the license status code.

usi.description: Unique system identifier of the record; pass it to fcc_spectrum_get_license.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor with the same filters for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Why nothing matched, what redaction excluded, or how to page further.

totalCount.description: Records matching the filters, across every page.

truncated.description: True when more records follow this page.

title: Search FCC ULS licenses
